# claude

Claude Code: its settings and a custom theme rendered from the palette. Also the Claude desktop app (`claude-desktop`, AUR), installed as is: it keeps its own settings.

`~/.claude/settings.json` (theme `custom:mango`, model, plugins, marketplaces) and `~/.claude/themes/mango.json` are linked from the repo like any config. Change settings by editing the repo file; if Claude Code ever replaces the link with a real file, `install.sh --check` reports it and the next `install.sh` backs it up and restores the link.

## Reference

<!-- generated by tools/docs: reference -->
**Packages** (`claude/packages`): `claude-code` (AUR), `claude-desktop` (AUR)

**Linked into your home** (stow, `install.sh --link`):

- `~/.claude/settings.json`
- `~/.claude/themes/mango.json`

**Rendered from the palette** (`theme`):

- `claude/.claude/themes/mango.json.tmpl` → `claude/.claude/themes/mango.json`: `accent`, `ansi13`, `bg_desktop`, `bg_hover`, `bg_surface`, `bg_widget`, `border_inactive`, `error`, `fg_disabled`, `fg_muted`, `fg_secondary`, `fg_text`, `link`, `name`, `selection_bg`, `success`, `term_bg`, `variant`, `warning`

**`reload.sh`** (run by `theme set`): ask for a restart when Claude Code is running. Claude Code reads its theme only when a session starts.
